criteria.F: Only described Rain behavior; no winding operation, administration, strategy variants or duration policy invented.
criteria.A: Box identity, spring condition, cylinder presence, tune identity, profile identity and strategy distinct; no human/organization prerequisite.
criteria.T: Playability definition and missing requirements consistent in simple and composed behavior.
criteria.U: Inspection, play request and Rain performance composition distinct purposes, not one Feature per internal operation.
criteria.C: Wound/absent and unwound/present covered; no tune plus preserved independent states on rejection; repeat after depletion stands alone.
criteria.P: M-2/Lark and expected winding/tune values explicit; cohesive missing requirement collection allowed.
criteria.I: Model the simulated mechanism through public operations; no invented human prerequisite or internal harness assertions.
criteria.L: Native English, parsed rows and concrete bindings.
criteria.D: Requested specs/open decisions only and editorial review/fallback disclosure.
criteria.O: Reuse prior executable objective; source facts support that purpose and do not substitute another asset.
criteria.B: One public action/query per Feature; no Features for implementation-only steps.
criteria.V: Completed Features @code only; no invented human actor.
